title: Review Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-critical-review agent. `kind: claim` attacks a claimed result; `kind: stop` attacks a decision to stop and must name its `termination_class` and `budget_left`. Both recompute from the raw sources this request points at, never from the author's summary, so the request carries pointers, not conclusions. A request with no claim or no artifact returns `invalid_input`.

oneOf.description: kind stop: the stop names its class

kind.description: 'claim': a result, document or hypothesis list. 'stop': a decision to stop; carries `termination_class` and `budget_left`, which a claim must not.

claim.description: The claim under review, in the author's words: the result and its numbers for a claim, or the stop and its stated reason for a stop.

artifacts.description: Paths of the raw sources behind the claim: write-ups, ledgers, gap files, bench logs, profile reports, roofline results.

job_ids.description: Compute job ids whose logs and artifacts back the claim, readable with `compute job logs` and `compute job artifacts`.

image_digests.description: Image digests each arm ran on, as `<arm>=<digest>`.

recipe_paths.description: Paths of each job's `recipe.yaml` read-back, the record of what actually ran.

noise_floor.description: The harness's run-to-run spread for this measurement. Absent means unmeasured, which the review reports as such.

source.description: Where the spread was measured: the job ids or the artifact.

termination_class.description: kind stop only, required there: the class the stop claims.

budget_left.description: kind stop only, required there: what the caller's ledger still allows, in TPU jobs and servers it may launch. No continuation may exceed it.

unexamined.description: kind stop only: candidates or cost classes the work never examined.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.claim: Flag --xla_tpu_enable_async_all_gather gives -8.1% T_mix on the stack head (4820 vs 5245 us).
MLA QK Rope gap stops at 31% closed: the kernel is at the floor.
